newsitem.title: UK: HSBC Holdings shares track Hong Kong gains.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Holdings shares track Hong Kong gains.

text.p: Shares in HSBC Holdings outpaced the rising market on Tuesday, tracking heavy gains overnight in Hong Kong, marketmakers said.
HSBC shares were up 30-1/2p at 1,296p by 1000 GMT in London. In Hong Kong, the shares rose HK$5.00 to HK$163.
"The shares had a very good run in Hong Kong and London is playing catch-up," one marketmaker said.
Others said the share's recent slide from a high of 1,316p in early November was "overdone". The share was hit by the strength of sterling and a sell recommendation on rival Hang Seng Bank.
Dealers said the share was likely to continue climbing but said they were keeping a wary eye on Hong Kong's stamina.
